_what: Raw battle accounts from mainnet, paired with the record tools/battle-record.py emits for the same battle. The cross-check fixture for lib/ww/battleRecord.ts: two implementations reading DIFFERENT sources - raw account bytes here, our pre-parsed census there - must agree field for field.
_source: Accounts: getAccountInfo on each battle_pda. Records: tools/battle-record.py run against data/chain-snapshot-2026-09-06 in the protocol repo.

emitter_field_sources.artist_a_id: unset: 52 profiles exist, no canonical artist id assigned
emitter_field_sources.fee_collection_wallet: chain: offset 100, caller-settable - the per-battle operator field
emitter_field_sources.input_assets_used: unset: no adapter exists, so nothing but SOL has ever entered
emitter_field_sources.launcher_wallet: chain: offset 257, equals the InitializeBattle fee payer (44/44)
emitter_field_sources.operator_attribution_basis: registry: which rule matched - fee_wallet, declared_redirect, explicit_claim, or unattributed
emitter_field_sources.operator_id: registry: bound in spec/operators.json, resolved by tools/resolve-operator.py. Null means UNATTRIBUTED and is never a default
emitter_field_sources.program_id: chain: the program that owns the account
emitter_field_sources.protocol_version: unset: nobody has defined what a protocol version is
emitter_field_sources.ranked: unset: no classification exists on chain or in the index (PRD 7)
emitter_field_sources.result_winner: record-layer: her judged winner, 2-of-3 for quick battles, panel for main events
emitter_field_sources.ruleset: unset: the 2-of-3 rule is documented in prose, never as an identifier
emitter_field_sources.settlement_asset: standard: SOL for every battle to date, and the program cannot settle anything else
emitter_field_sources.settlement_winner: chain: offset 244, always the larger pool (1,482/1,482)
emitter_field_sources.start_time: chain: offset 20, equals the battle id
emitter_field_sources.total_volume_lamports: derived: buy and sell legs from the vault's own history
emitter_field_sources.track_a_id: unset: 929 songs keyed by permalink, no canonical track id
emitter_field_sources.unique_traders: derived: distinct signers across this battle's events
emitter_field_sources.vault_pda: chain: derived PDA, seeds (b"battle_vault", battle_id le64)
